title: Meta brings its short-form video feed of AI slop to Europe
description: Meta says that since the launch of Vibes, media generation in the Meta AI app has jumped more than tenfold.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Subtle Computing’s voice isolation models help computers understand you in noisy environments
description: Subtle Computing has raised $6 million in seed funding to build voice-isolation models. The startup plans to announce a hardware device next year.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Inception raises $50 million to build diffusion models for code and text
description: Diffusion models already power AI image generators, but Inception thinks they can be even more powerful applied in software development.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Google Maps upgrades navigation in India with Gemini, safety alerts
description: India becomes the second market after the U.S. to get Gemini-powered navigation on Google Maps.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Perplexity to pay Snap $400M to power search in Snapchat
description: Snap said today that it has signed a deal with AI-powered search engine Perplexity to power a new chatbot. As part of the deal, Perplexity will pay Snap $400 million in cash and equity.
author: Ivan Mehta
